notes.title: 《幽影密讯》免费DLC Steam现已发布！
notes.notes:
大家好，感谢大家的支持！
《山河旅探》联动《唐探1900》的免费DLC《幽影密讯》已经预发布啦！大家更新Steam游戏包就可以获得。《幽影密讯》比原定的1月29日时间早两天，在接下来的几天内，我们将会根据大家反馈对游戏进行调整。如下是大家可能关心的一些问题：

Q：DLC游戏时长多久？
A：约3-5个小时，取决于您对解谜游戏的熟练程度；

Q：是否需要下载专门的DLC安装包？
A：此次更新的DLC无需额外下载专门的安装包，只需等待新版本发布后更新游戏本体即可体验；

Q：领取服饰奖励是否有时间限制？
A: 通关后解锁的主角服饰奖励无时间限制，DLC上线后您可随时完成游戏并领取奖励；

Q：是否需要先通关游戏本体？
开启DLC内容前，我们强烈建议您先通关游戏本体。完成后，可通过主菜单的章节选择功能自由跳转至任意章节节点；

Q：跟本体的玩法有什么不同？
此次DLC为解谜和探案双线并行，需要提醒大家的是，许多解谜环节并不局限于游戏本体内，需要大家开阔思路，在可能之处寻找线索。

Q：Mac是否会同步更新？
非常抱歉，DLC的Mac版本仍在制作中，我们计划于春节后正式推出，敬请期待！

也有许多小伙伴问我们在6月份的时候曾发布过关于山河旅探第一款DLC《夺命幻戏》的预告PV，这一款DLC的进度如何呢？与上文提到的《幽影密讯》又有什么关系呢？

其实在12月份的时候，我们曾发布过一个关于《夺命幻戏》不得不的延期的说明。

《夺命幻戏》延期的原因在于，在项目组内部测试阶段，我们发现已经完成的案件体验非常糟糕。经过一些艰难评估后，我们决定推翻案件的底层设计，从剧本阶段重新来过。在最开始的计划中，《夺命幻戏》是一个发生在魔术舞台上的案件，因此我们希望结合魔术手法来进行案件的诡计设计。但在测试中发现，案件的解密过程——也就是揭露魔术手法的过程，特别像《走进科学》，在揭示真相后，会给人很强的“就这……”的感觉。这种天谜地解的情况，与我们期待的反转感有很大的落差。

这个问题在项目早期的剧本阶段就有所暴露，但当时我们误认为那是文字的表现力不足造成的，因此没有及时进行纠正。我们又复盘了一些其它同类型的推理作品，发现涉及到揭露魔术手法的桥段，都有类似的问题。这让我们痛苦地意识到，我们在走的这条路，很可能从根源上就是走不通的。

经过一些反思，我们意识到，想要设计出一个好的魔术杀人案件，对于魔术，我们应该取其神，而不是取其形。为此，我们去自学了一些魔术课程，又专门拜访了几位魔术师，才逐渐体会到：魔术是一项表演艺术，魔术手法并不是它的核心；它的精髓在于注意力控制，也就是网上常说的“misdirection”——错误引导。

因此，我们决定重新出发，推翻原有的剧本，用新的理念，重新设计案件的核心诡计。

在发布延期声明后，有许多小伙伴也来问是否可以把《夺命幻戏》的废案也放出来。在我们思考后，我们决定把废案中的部分元素进行再创作加工，加入了一些我们后来开发中的灵感，形成了一套新的方案，那就是大家即将体验到的《幽影密讯》。

非常抱歉《夺命幻戏》要让大家多等待一些时间了。但请相信，我们会用更高的标准完成这个DLC，不辜负大家的期待。还请多给我们一些耐心。我们会用更充分的时间，为大家带来一个更好的案件设计！

notes.title: 30% discount during Chinese New Year Festival!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you for your support of [b][u]Murders on the Yangtze River.[/u][/b]

During the Chinese New Year period, [u]Murders on the Yangtze River[/u] will be collaborating with an upcoming film that is set to release during the Chinese New Year. 

This crossover event, titled[b] [u]Messages from the Shadow[/u][/b], will be a large-scale, reality-intrusive mystery puzzle chapter that spans history, games, and the real world. As a historical detective game, [u][b]Messages from the Shadow [/b][/u]also brings a mysterious case based on real historical events. It takes place in 1910, in the Far East's financial hub—Shanghai. In this turbulent era, a storm that will change the course of Chinese history is about to hit the banks of the Huangpu River.

The crossover event is scheduled to go live on January 26, Beijing time. However, we regret to inform you that some of the puzzles are designed in a way that may require a certain level of understanding of Chinese to complete, and some clues are hidden in Simplified Chinese social media platforms such as Weibo and Bilibili. Accessing these social websites may be difficult for users outside of mainland China.

However, from January 27 to February 10, during the Chinese New Year, Murders on the Yangtze River will be offering a special low-discount promotion. If you're interested, don't miss out!

Once again, thank you for your support and wish you happiness and all the best in the new year!

"Magic, a trick of deception
A cunning art to manipulate attention
On stage, the magician’s feats mystify
With dazzling displays
and bold pretension

notes.title: Updates and Events in June
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are excited to announce that at the end of June, Murders on the Yangtze River will be bringing a series of updates and events:

[b]New Version Release:[/b] We are planning to release a new version of Murders on the Yangtze River next week. In this version, we are introducing the Traditional Chinese version of the game. It is important to note that the game’s voiceovers are still in Simplified Chinese, so there may be some differences between the voiceovers and the Traditional Chinese subtitles. However, all subtitles have been localized according to the conventions of Traditional Chinese-using regions.

New Features and Optimizations:
[b]1) Skip Button: [/b]We have added a skip button in the chase sequence of Chapter 5 and the infiltration sequence of Chapter 6. If you are unable to pass these sequences after several attempts, you can choose to skip them.
[b]2) Hint System:[/b] A new hint system has been added to help players navigate the game better.
[b]3) Performance Optimization:[/b] Comprehensive optimizations have been made to enhance the overall game performance and experience.
[b]4) UI Enhancements:[/b] Some UI elements have been optimized.
[b]5) Bug Fixes:[/b] Several known bugs have been fixed.
[b]6) English version Enhancements:[/b] English subtitles improved. 

Due to the new version's code architecture being different from the old version, reading old save files may still cause game anomalies despite our efforts. Therefore, [b]we recommend that after updating, you do not load old save files but continue the game through the [Chapter Select] feature and then save again. Your unlocked achievements, collectibles, and endings will not be affected. [/b]We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

[b]DLC Preview: [/b]At the end of June, we will release the preview of the first DLC for Murders on the Yangtze River, titled [u]The Last Magic Trick[/u]. Interested players can look forward to the trailer.

[b]Steam Summer Sale: [/b]During the 14-day Steam Summer Sale starting on June 28, Murders on the Yangtze River will be available at a 20% discount, the lowest price ever. Interested players should not miss out!

Thank you for your continued support and love. We hope you continue to enjoy the adventures in Murders on the Yangtze River!

notes.title: We have some news about the first DLC！
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for your attention and support for Murders on the Yangtze River!

After the release of “Murders on the Yangtze River”, many players have been asking about when the first DLC will be released and what it will be about.
Taking advantage of the Eastern Game Festival, we are very glad to reveal our DLC plans!

Firstly, what can we say about the first DLC?
As we all know, after the final case, Mr. Shen needs to temporarily leave Shanghai and recuperate in Yangzhou. During this time, someone is murdered in the midst of a magic performance in Lyceum Theater. Who is the murderer, and what conspiracies will be uncovered?
Currently, the main character in the DLC is tentatively the journalist Wen Ko-hsin, but Mr. Shen and Ah Fu will also play important roles in the DLC!
Of course, the above storyline is just a little tidbit of information. Changes to the storyline direction based on actual developments during game production are also very likely to occur.
We aim to elevate the suspense and freshness of the case, bringing a new gameplay experience and case design to everyone!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/dff797e1922d7605f2fcc69e6adf3668d5e04b36.png[/img]

Secondly, when will the first DLC be released?
All we can say is, as soon as possible! In fact, after the Spring Festival, our team members have already intensively started learning various magic techniques and have even hired professional magicians as case design consultants.
According to plot designers, there is already an initial plan for the murder case, but of course, there is still a long way to go before the final version is ready to meet everyone. We will do our best to expedite!
Currently, we hope to meet everyone with the first DLC within the year!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/b5a6e883de862e9da851654cc408f952104010f2.gif[/img]

Lastly, besides the first DLC, will there be any more to follow?
It is highly likely! In fact, there are several mysteries in the main story that have not been revealed yet, such as who Shanghai Phantom is or if there are hidden secrets behind Ah Fu’s father’s explosion case.
These stories have been brewing in the minds of our team members for some time, and we hope to unveil them gradually.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/df283123b013dc6759fe55cbed551cecb8cf4f41.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/c1a852388a79fe37bf2f16f273b5bc68f24880e5.jpg[/img]

Apart from the DLC plans, we will soon release the official theme song for “Murders on the Yangtze River”!

In conclusion, please continue to follow our game!

notes.title: The solution to the bug in the second half of Chapter Five
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After updating the new storyline yesterday, we received feedback from some players that if they had already played up to Chapter Five before the update, they might encounter a display error during the deduction part at the London Police Department, which could prevent the game from continuing.

If you have encountered this issue, you can solve it by selecting the chapter from the main menu, then choosing Chapter Five and selecting the most recent chapter checkpoint to continue the game.

This bug occurs randomly, mainly due to some incompatibilities between old version saves and new version saves. We are currently working on fixing this issue and expect to release an update to resolve it next week.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.

notes.title: Update for better English translation
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We're excited to announce a new update today, thanks to the invaluable feedback we've received from many of you.

Over the past week, we've been dedicated to enhancing the English version of the game in the following ways:

[b]Correcting and refining English names for all characters: [/b]We understand the importance of accurate and immersive character names, so we've taken the time to ensure that every character's name is appropriately translated and reflects their identity within the game.

[b]Addressing translation issues: [/b] Polish sentences and wordings.

[b]Changing language default settings: [/b]If your operating system language is not Chinese (simplified or traditional), the game's default language will be English.  

Furthermore, we've included a brief conversation at the end of Chapter 5. This conversation provides clearer insight into the circumstances surrounding Shen Po-an's demise, offering players a more comprehensive understanding of the storyline.

We hope these updates enhance your gaming experience, and we're grateful for your continued support and feedback as we strive to make our game even better.

notes.title: Secrets behind the Chinese-style Ink Wash Game "Murders on the Yangtze River"
notes.notes:
"Murders on the Yangtze River" is a horizontal axis Chinese-style whodunnit detective game happened in the 1900s, which is an age of turbulence in China where Eastern and Western cultures as well as the ancient and the modern collided and combined.

What would have happened in this series of detective games?
Why the developers choose this time period as the background of the game?
How the daily life and daily things in this era are represented in this games?
Perhaps you can find out in this video.

notes.title: ON AIR NOW ! Let's play !
notes.notes:
Suspenseful case, Diverse investigation, Rigorous reasoning, Intense debate. Chinese-style detective game "Murders on the Yangtze River" is coming!

In this game, you'll take on the role of a refined gentleman, John Shen, with a sharp intellect, embarking on a journey through early 20th century China to solve a series of intriguing cases along the Yangtze River.

There are also hidden surprises in the demo which you can’t miss out!! Come and join the wishlist!

notes.title: 《山河旅探》中的钢铁，是怎样炼成的？
notes.notes:
《山河旅探》中的钢铁，是怎样炼成的？

在《山河旅探》第三案里，沈仲平和阿福穿梭在机械声轰鸣的汉阳铁厂中寻找凶手时，大家是否对汉阳铁厂里面的机器感到好奇呢？如此壮观的“大怪物门”到底是如何在工人的安排下有条不紊地炼钢呢？
今天我们就来为大家展开讲讲汉阳铁厂案中的机械到底是什么来历、它们在当年又是如何运作的。

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/ced3b921f7fdc0720966839104bc66fffef9205c.png[/img]
一层车间


1、钢水包（一层车间）
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/6c701af7185a5c7936838095c08465b72d4802be.png[/img]
开场「炸裂」的钢水包，在平时炼钢过程中，除了作为盛装钢水的容器外，还具备对钢水进行调温、精炼处理等功能，是平炉车间的关键设备。

汉阳铁厂的钢水包是由英国都黑氏公司制造的，足足有2米多高，一次约能装30吨钢水。

2、西门子-马丁炉（一层车间）
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/ac3c30be9557e2c2657fa9f26b1a9686b345e315.png[/img]
西门子-马丁炉是以发明者西门子和马丁命名的一种炼钢炉，即“平炉”。
汉阳铁厂炼钢用两种方法，一为酸性，一为碱性，酸性为贝塞麦转炉，碱性就是这个马丁平炉了。酸性钢含磷高，影响钢轨质量，因此汉阳铁厂不惜斥巨资引入德国的马丁炉。
马丁炉最大的优点就是：能用任何比例的生铁和废钢为炉料，生产出各种优质的钢种。

3、吊钩（一层车间）
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/441dd2cf2c5eeff4ddfe43c24f50b0194b0be003.png[/img]
起重机的吊钩，样式为常见的羊角式。
吊钩的工作原理是借助于滑轮组等部件，悬挂在起重机的钢丝绳上，从而吊起50吨的重物。而吊钩的主要工作就是用来运送钢水包的。

4、蒸汽机
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/d15bab8f67a110aafb41851a5a9af7d217400b93.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/1cd1b2c2fc1faf847c32d372287dba72bd485095.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/1d09f8159872e831669ee6210e8d57cecc8e0bf3.png[/img]
1906年，张之洞为锻造中国钢铁工业，引进由英国戴维兄弟公司生产的8000匹马力双缸卧式蒸汽机，这台蒸汽机代表着当时世界工业的最高水平。
1985年，电动机取代了蒸汽机，这台蒸汽机作为中国最后一台以蒸汽机作动力的轧钢原动机，完成了历史使命。


这么多老式的钢铁设备，游戏制作组的同学到底是如何将它们还原在游戏中的呢？为此我们特意采访制作组同学：
“在游戏制作过程中，为了将真实的汉阳钢铁厂呈现在大家眼前，我们特意和历史老师反复确认老机械的年代，同时查找了许多旧资料研究机械运作原理。每个零部件到底是怎么转动的、机械动作全部合成后是否与当年机械的运作规律一致……这些细小的问题看起来好像与游戏关系不大，而且大家游戏时也并不会将很多视线放到机械上，但我们觉得细节上打磨得完美，会给大家营造出更加沉浸的探案氛围，而这些都需要极大耐心进行思考和制作。”

现在，《山河旅探》的第三案「炉边崇影」正在参加Steam新品节，欢迎更多的小伙伴们来试玩！

notes.title: “活人祭炉”居然是真的？！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/bf4e441ad1fb4407091eca675806a8bc70f86cfe.png[/img]
“夫神物之化，须人而成。”

《山河旅探》第三章--「炉边崇影」案的PV中有提到，
汉阳铁厂里的工人们纷纷传言，
厂里发生的命案是干将莫邪显灵，
这时候就有好多小伙伴不禁询问，
难道历史上，
干将莫邪的传说还真的是跟“活人祭炉”有关？！

干将莫邪的最早记载是出现在西汉刘向的《列士传》里，
讲的是春秋时期，
干将、莫邪夫妻二人用三年时间铸造了一雄一雌两把绝世宝剑，
但他们知道，
绝世珍宝肯定瞒不过当时多疑残暴的君王--晋君，
只有献出宝剑才是上策。

但干将担心，
多疑的晋君即便得到了宝剑，
也不会放过他们夫妻二人，
于是干将在把雌剑献给晋君之前，
先将雄剑托给妻子莫邪，
让她传给儿子赤鼻，
而后，干将果然为晋君所杀。
赤鼻长大后，誓要为父报仇，
最终在一位游侠的帮助下成功将晋君杀死。

由此可见，
“干将莫邪”的最早版本，
已经集齐了权谋、铸剑、弑君、复仇等爆款N要素。
但估计是当时的古人觉得这故事还不够劲爆，
便将这个故事越传越离谱~
后来的版本中竟然加入了“活人祭炉”的剧情！
（这都是什么阴间操作啊喂！）

这个版本说的是：
当初干将莫邪夫妇铸剑时，
花了足足三个月的时间，
但却连矿石都没有熔开。
无奈之下，
两人跳入熔炉之中（还有一说是只有莫邪），
倾尽血肉与气节，
才得以铸成两把灵气之剑。

如果将这件事情放到物理角度来说，
在青铜时代古人多用燃烧木炭增温来锻造兵器，
兵器多由铜与铁来制造，
铜的熔点是1083℃，
但铁的熔点比铜高，需要达到1538℃才能熔化，
而二者之间的温度差，是燃烧多少木炭都达不到的……
这时转折点就出现了，
人体中含有的大量脂肪一旦经过高温炙烤，
便会转化成高浓度的油脂，
这些油脂就是进一步增加炉温的极佳燃料。
当然这只是为了增加故事戏剧性的一种说法啦~

那么，
难道第三案的领工真的是因为干将莫邪显灵而 “以身炼钢”？？？
又或许，是有人从中做蛊？？
汉阳铁厂里的鬼神之说的迷雾下，
到底有什么不可告人的秘密？

notes.title: 【高能预警！】这一次，我们把百年前的汉阳铁厂搬来了！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/ee529ae8e2687883f94c9cb083c9e56f8b85a9ac.png[/img]

「晚清时期」、「蒸汽朋克」
两个隔着巨大鸿沟的词语，
却早在百年前，
就真真实实地合体出现在人们的生活中！

晚清的天空，笼罩着危机的阴霾。
张之洞意识到，
钢铁是军事工业和民用工业的基础，
绝不可依赖进口，中国人必须能自己生产钢铁。
汉阳铁厂由此诞生。

之所以把铁厂选在汉阳，大佬心里有一个小算盘：
汉阳虽然既不产铁也不产煤，但胜在水陆交通便利。
炼钢遗留下来的矿渣和煤渣，可用来构筑防洪的堤坝，
使武汉人民免受洪水的危害。

另外，他还有一个执念：
“能每天看到汉阳铁厂的烟囱冒烟，我心里才踏实呐！”
（张之洞时任湖广总督，总督府与汉阳铁厂仅一江之隔。）

在张之洞的主持下，
1890年，
汉阳铁厂在湖北龟山下动工兴建。

由此，
虽在晚清，
但此时最具蒸汽朋克的场景便出现在了人们的眼前。

[b]如此磅礴的铁与火的年代
这一次，
被搬到了《山河旅探》当中！[/b]

湖北作为主角旅途中的必经地，
而汉阳铁厂又是武汉百年来的地标建筑。
这个传统与现代碰撞与融合的见证者，
就是清末民初的时代特色的最好表达。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319733/fc81703c3e4be92d3def86d5dd35062ebc83406d.png[/img]

沈仲平和阿福会在汉阳铁厂遇到什么怪事？
[b]《山河旅探》第三章--「炉边祟影」
即将在10月3日的Steam试玩节与大家见面！[/b]
千万不要错过哟！
